title: AI VTuber operator memory seed
description: Operator-owned performer-level facts loaded into working memory at startup (ADR-0008 S2, #321). The same format is what `aivtuberctl memory-export` writes. There is deliberately no field that can name a viewer or an actor, and unknown fields are refused. Bounds mirror crates/app/src/memory_seed.rs; the loader additionally requires each claim to be at most 240 UTF-8 bytes, one line, and unique after case and whitespace folding, which JSON Schema cannot express.
